//! A doc comment on the module.
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Parses `input` into tokens.
pub fn parse(input: &str, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<Token>, ParseError> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let table: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();
    // A line comment with an unmatched ( paren inside it.
    let literal = "a { brace ) in a string";
    let escaped = "tab\there";
    let raw = r#"raw ] ["#;
    let ch = '{';
    for (index, item) in input.chars().enumerate() {
        if index >= limit || item == ch {
            break;
        }
        out.push(Token::new(item, index as u32, true));
    }
    println!("{} {:?} {}", literal, escaped, raw);
    Ok(out)
}

struct Token { value: char, offset: u32, valid: bool }

impl Token {
    fn new(value: char, offset: u32, valid: bool) -> Self {
        Self { value, offset, valid }
    }
}
